name: compliance_checking
description: Checks project configuration, dependency licenses, and code patterns against a compliance policy. Reports violations and license incompatibilities.

outputs.name: compliance_report
outputs.description: { licenses: [{package, license, approved, comment}], policy_violations: [{rule, severity, file, remediation}], overall_compliant: bool }

error_codes.message: No compliance policy configured and no default available.
error_codes.recovery: Return best-effort license listing; skip policy checks.

examples: project_root with unknown-license dependency -> compliance_report with violation.
